**Coaching Note:**

Your knight on e2 has a powerful check on g3! When White captures with hxg3, you sacrifice the knight but leave the king fatally exposed. Your rook then delivers checkmate on h5—the king is trapped by its own pawns at g2 and h2. Always look for forcing checks that expose the enemy king, even if it costs material. When the king loses escape squares, sacrifice tactics often lead to mate.
